raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Move the XPU image to the oneAPI 2026.1.3 patch release, matching sgl-project/sgl-kernel-xpu#537, and pick up the sglang-kernel-xpu 0.5.0 wheel.

## Modifications

- `docker/xpu.Dockerfile`: `intel/deep-learning-essentials:2026.1.2-devel-ubuntu24.04` → `2026.1.3-devel-ubuntu24.04`
- `python/pyproject_xpu.toml`: `sglang-kernel-xpu` wheel `v0.4.0+xpu/sglang_kernel_xpu-0.4.0` → `v0.5.0+xpu/sglang_kernel_xpu-0.5.0` (`cp310-abi3-manylinux_2_38_x86_64`)

PyTorch version is unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A, base image patch bump and kernel wheel bump.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Notes

- The tag `2026.1.3-devel-ubuntu24.04` is published on Docker Hub (2026-08-31).
- The 0.5.0 wheel is published on [sgl-project/whl v0.5.0+xpu](https://github.com/sgl-project/whl/releases/tag/v0.5.0%2Bxpu).
- PR XPU CI (`pr-test-xpu.yml`) pulls the prebuilt nightly image via `scripts/ci/xpu/xpu_ci_start_container.sh` and does not build `docker/xpu.Dockerfile`. The new base image is first built by `release-docker-intel-xpu-nightly.yml` after merge. To validate before merge:

```bash
docker build -t sglang:xpu -f docker/xpu.Dockerfile .
```

---

Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:white_check_mark: [Run #40447659156](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40447659156)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->

@arathi-hlab 

This bump also fixes wrong output with XPU decode graphs at TP > 1, which looks like the root cause of #45034.

With the current base image (`deep-learning-essentials:2026.1.2`), TP > 1 decode graphs skip the all-reduce: every rank logs

```
[onecclAllReduce] caught std::exception: ext_oneapi_get_graph() can only be called on recording queues.
```

and the output is garbage. With this PR the errors are gone and the output is correct. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, TP=8 on 8x Arc Pro B60, `--cuda-graph-backend-decode full --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled`, sonnet 1024/1024 at 32 concurrent requests:

| image | greedy "The capital of France is" | oneCCL errors in server log | output tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-xpu` | ` acreoooé ? ? ?crecrecre ...` | ~14,800 | 500 (not valid: collectives skipped) |
| `main` (316ff4dce2), current Dockerfile | ` a city!!!!!!! expend expend expend ...` | 15,486 | 500 (not valid) |
| `main` (316ff4dce2) + this PR's two changes | ` a city of love, art, fashion, and cuisine. Paris, the City of Light, ...` | 0 | 419 |
